## Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
install.packages('vegan')
library(vegan)
```

## Shannon's Diversity Index

```{r Shannon's Diversity Index}

#abundance of each bird species at transect 9
birds_transect_9 <- c(1,1,2,1,1,1)

#abundance of each bird species at transect 13
birds_transect_13 <- c(1,1,2,1,3,1,2,1,1,1,1)

#abundance of each bird species at transect 14
birds_transect_14 <- c(1,1,1,1,8,1,1,1,1,3,1,4,1,1)

#learning about the diversity function
help(diversity)

#calculating shannon's diversity index for transect 9
diversity(birds_transect_9)

#calculating shannon's diversity index for transect 13
diversity(birds_transect_13)

#calculating shannon's diversity index for transect 14
diversity(birds_transect_14)
```
